local_worldY_direction_diagnostic.interpretation: At the observed nearest foot/front-strap pair, +worldY increases separation to first order and -worldY decreases it. This local fixed-pair derivative supports testing positiveY away from this front strap, but does not certify whole-foot/whole-strap clearance or a robot/body route; another nearest pair may take over. No new offset search was performed.
